description: Top-level structured response from the LLM.

segments.description: Ordered list of response segments with positional commands

items.description: A single segment of the response tied to a chunk of displayed text.

emotions.description: Declarative emotional tags for this segment, not executable commands

attitude_change.description: Proposed attitude change, accepted only with the reply

boredom_change.description: Proposed boredom change, accepted only with the reply

stress_change.description: Proposed stress change, accepted only with the reply
